math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}x<0\Rightarrow -x>0\\f(-x)=(-x)^{2}+4(-x)=x^{2} - 4 x\\f(x)=f(-x)=x^{2} - 4 x\\x\ge 0\text{ 时，}f(x)=x^{2}+4x\\f(x)=\begin{cases}x^{2} - 4 x,&x<0\\x^{2} + 4 x,&x\ge 0\end{cases}\\x\in D\text{ 时，}f(x)=x^{2} + 4 \left|{x}\right|\end{gathered}$$
